name: SafeText AI — Cyberbullying Detection System
description: An AI-powered system that detects cyberbullying and toxic content in text, compares predictions across multiple models, and provides real-time classification with confidence scores through an interactive application.

name: AI Contract Intelligence System
description: A full-stack contract review app that detects risky clauses and drafts clearer rewrites. I fine-tuned LegalBERT with LoRA and PEFT on roughly 13,000 CUAD annotations across 49 clause categories; the classifier reached about 70% accuracy and a 0.65 F1 score. A retrieval-augmented workflow adds context to review, with FastAPI services and a Streamlit interface.
